name: Ridge Road Shopping Center
summary: Ridge Road Shopping Center is a community-focused retail destination in Forney, Texas, managed by the area's leading commercial real estate firm with over 30 years of local expertise. The center serves the rapidly growing eastern Dallas suburbs with convenient access to everyday shopping and services.
demographics: Ridge Road Shopping Center serves the growing Forney, Texas community, which attracts young families and middle-income households drawn to the area's affordable housing and proximity to Dallas employment centers. The trade area encompasses eastern Dallas suburbs including Fate, Sunnyvale, and Seagoville, with residents typically in the 25-54 age range with household incomes ranging from $50,000-$90,000. The center caters to convenience-oriented shoppers seeking everyday services and retail in a suburban setting, with visitors prioritizing accessibility and practical shopping experiences over luxury amenities.
description: Ridge Road Shopping Center is located at 680 Innovation Boulevard in Forney, Texas, serving the rapidly growing eastern Dallas metropolitan area. Managed by Ridge Pointe Commercial Real Estate, the longest-running and most experienced commercial real estate firm in Rockwall County, this shopping center benefits from deep local expertise and strong community connections. Ridge Pointe specializes in serving the under-served communities east of the Metroplex, including Rockwall, Rowlett, Forney, Fate, and Heath, bringing institutional-level commercial real estate experience to the local market. The center operates Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM and maintains a strong 4.4-star rating from over 417 customer reviews. With its strategic location in one of Texas's fastest-growing suburban corridors, Ridge Road Shopping Center provides convenient access to retail, restaurant, and service businesses for the expanding Forney community and surrounding Lake Ray Hubbard area.
